summary: Users log in and receive roles directly or through teams. Never delete the default system administrator user: the containerized installer uses it to register services with platform gateway, and installs and upgrades fail without it; if deleted, set gateway_admin_user in the inventory to another admin account.
questions: Can I delete the default admin user in AAP?
Installation or upgrade fails after deleting the admin user
How do I sort users by email?

answer_card.title: Deleted the default admin user
answer_card.answer_md:
The containerized installer registers services with platform gateway using the default system administrator, so installs and upgrades fail if it was deleted. Set an alternative admin account in the installer inventory before rerunning:
```ini
[all:vars]
gateway_admin_user=<existing_admin_username>
```
